summary: Reviewed all three files changed in WP-005: menu.sh, menu.cmd, and package.json.
menu.sh: shebang, cd-to-dirname, and quoted $@ are all correct. Symlink edge case (dirname vs realpath) is a known limitation acceptable for a first-release launcher. No structural or safety issues.
menu.cmd: @echo off, cd /d %~dp0, and %* are all idiomatic and correct. Exit-code propagation is handled implicitly by cmd.exe. No issues.

package.json: main, keywords, repository, and files fields all match the WP-005 spec exactly. Existing fields (bin, engines, scripts, dependencies) are untouched. JSON is well-formed with consistent 4-space indentation.

Three carry-forward low-priority items acknowledged: (1) dist/ in files bundles compiled test artefacts (~700kB); (2) repository.url is a placeholder — must be updated before npm publish; (3) no .gitattributes eol=lf guard for menu.sh on Windows checkouts. All three are pre-publish housekeeping, not blockers.
All 9 acceptance criteria confirmed met. PASS.

comments.note: menu.sh: dirname "$0" resolves the symlink's location, not the real file's location. If menu.sh is ever symlinked, the cd will target the wrong directory. A robust fix would be: cd "$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")" . Acceptable as-is for a direct-install distribution scenario.

package.json repository.url is a placeholder ('https://github.com/user/repo-parallelizer'). Must be replaced with the actual repository URL before running npm publish. Carry-forward from Developer and QA observations.

No .gitattributes file exists. Adding 'menu.sh text eol=lf' would prevent Git on Windows from converting the shebang line to CRLF, which would break bash execution. Recommended pre-publish housekeeping. Carry-forward from Developer and QA observations.

dist/ in the files field bundles compiled test artefacts (dist/tests/ and dist/server/__tests__/), approximately 700kB of the 1.4MB unpacked tarball.
